entries.schema: NDJSON fire rows / fires-v1 (seq + occurrenceKey + executionGeneration + phase registered|dispatched|running|reconciled + outcome succeeded|failed|needs_you|skipped|unknown)
entries.writePrimitive: repairMissionChangeTornTail + appendFile through a per-process serialized chain (the session-changes primitive, same as steward-inbox)
entries.corruption: torn tail truncated before append; unparsable rows and rows whose phase is outside the four-phase whitelist are skipped by readers
entries.capacity: append-only; four rows per fire at most, bounded by the per-task and global daily caps above
entries.cache: the monotonic seq and the per-occurrence attempt counter are rebuilt from the tail at load; no other in-process cache
entries.recovery: the ledger is the record itself: a crashed run is reconciled as outcome unknown on the next boot (never as success, never re-dispatched), and DELETE of a task deliberately leaves its rows in place
entries.exemptionReason: append-only ledger cannot use whole-file JSON replacement

entries.corruption: invalid or older schema triggers full rebuild (65: bounded run-health summaries and latest persisted healthRuns must replace older materialized cards even when session files are unchanged; execution identity remains a live overlay only)
entries.exemptionReason: fully regenerable materialized index
